thread.title: Henderson Flash claim OVL Championship - NewsBreak

author: Ronald Clark
title: Henderson Flash claim OVL Championship - NewsBreak
text:
By Ronald Clark No media credit provided. ,
1 hours ago
HENDERSON, Ky. (WEHT) — The Henderson Flash are the 2026 Ohio Valley League Champions after sweeping the Hoptown Hoppers in the championship series.
The Flash finished the regular season as the number one seed in the league and earned a first round bye to start the postseason. Henderson swept the Madisonville Miners in the semifinals by a margin of 35-4. In the finals, the Flash beat the Hoppers 16-13 in game one before claiming the OVL title with a 15-7 win Wednesday night in Hopkinsville.
The championship roster includes four former Oakland City players in Alec Satterfield, Clark Gries, Reed Rheinhardt, and Ashton Tindle. University of Southern Indiana pitchers Colin Wolfe and Kiefer Parsons were also on the team. The Flash also included a lot of representation from the Tri-State including Evansville (IN), Henderson (KY), Princeton (IN), and Boonville (IN).
